en: <CLT=cltMIND>It's this red door, right?

Ah, Kaede...
I have one more question...

Do you really think it's one of us...?
Not just the culprit...
But the mastermind as well?
Huh? Isn't that what you told me, Shuichi?
Y-Yes, but...

It's just... That was only my deduction, 
I don't know if I should trust that...

Well, I don't know if it's true, either.
But that's why we need to confirm it.

If you just dismiss a possibility and look the
other way without confirming anything...

...then you're just turning your back on the
truth.

What's the matter, Shuichi? You seemed so
sure of yourself during the investigation.
Ah, sorry...

Let's go.
I'm sure they're waiting for us inside.
